reports.title: WEX Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance and Assumptions
section: The Company provides revenue guidance on a GAAP basis and earnings guidance on a non-GAAP basis due to the uncertainty and the indeterminate amount of certain elements that are included in reported GAAP earnings.

•For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue in the range of $760 million to $780 million and adjusted net income in the range of $193 million to $200 million, or $5.67 to $5.87 per diluted share.

•For the full year 2026, the Company now expects revenue in the range of $2.97 billion to $2.99 billion and adjusted net income in the range of $736 million to $743 million, or $21.28 to $21.48 per diluted share, compared to previous guidance for revenue of $2.86 billion to $2.90 billion and adjusted net income of $689 million to $703 million, or $19.68 to $20.08 per diluted share.
The Company’s guidance is based on the following assumptions:

•U.S. retail fuel prices of $4.81 and $4.50 per gallon for the fourth quarter and full year 2026, respectively, based on the applicable NYMEX futures curve from the week of October 19, 2026. This does not include any potential future impacts from European fuel spreads.
•Adjusted net income effective tax rate of 25.0% for both the fourth quarter and full year.
•Mobility credit losses in the range of 17 to 22 basis points for the fourth quarter and 16 to 17 basis points for the full year.

•Weighted average diluted shares outstanding of 34.1 million and 34.6 million for the fourth quarter and full year, respectively. This assumption does not include any further share repurchases that have been or may be consummated beyond the approximately $260 million bought through Q3.
For additional information regarding our financial guidance assumptions, please see the Q3 2026 earnings supplemental materials filed with the SEC and available on our website.
